problem: Workspaces currently contain a Platform Project wrapper before users can organize linked Identity Projects, even though the Platform Project has no separate lifecycle or ownership meaning. This adds unnecessary navigation and makes it harder to add other resource types directly to a Workspace.
invariants: Each Identity Project is linked to at most one Workspace.
Unlinking removes only the Platform reference and never changes the Identity resource.
Workspace roles never grant Identity permissions; all Identity reads use the signed-in user's authorization.
Migration preserves Workspace IDs, memberships, invitations, account defaults, and every existing Identity Project link.

context.outcome: An authenticated account organizes Identity Projects and future connected resource types directly in its Workspaces, without an intermediate Platform Project or changes to Identity ownership and permissions.
context.scope: A Workspace is the collaboration and resource-organization boundary. Its resource links are visible only to direct Workspace members; Identity resource details are additionally authorized by Identity for the current user.

useCases.name: Provision and list Workspaces
preconditions: Caller has a trusted authenticated Identity subject
useCases.result: Idempotently provision and return the account's default My workspace while preserving existing Workspace IDs, membership, and default selection.

useCases.name: Administer Workspace and membership
preconditions: Caller is a Workspace owner or administrator
useCases.result: Manage Workspace metadata, direct membership, invitations, and resource links without granting Identity permissions.

useCases.name: Invite or accept a Workspace member
preconditions: Acceptance requires a valid invitation, normalized email match, and successful fixed-login-project onboarding
useCases.result: Add membership to exactly the invited Workspace; Identity onboarding failure creates no Workspace membership.

useCases.name: Link an Identity Project to a Workspace
preconditions: Caller is a Workspace owner or administrator
Identity Project is visible to the caller through the signed-in user's Identity authorization
Identity Project is not linked to another Workspace
useCases.result: Create a typed Workspace resource reference to the Identity Project without copying credentials or mutating Identity.

useCases.name: Unlink an Identity Project from a Workspace
preconditions: Caller is a Workspace owner or administrator
The Identity Project is linked to that Workspace
useCases.result: Remove only the Workspace resource reference; leave the Identity Project and its lifecycle unchanged.

useCases.name: Read Workspace resource sections
preconditions: Caller has active direct membership in the Workspace
useCases.result: Return typed resource sections, initially Identity Projects, with live summaries authorized for the current Identity bearer; show generic access-needed or unavailable states and preserve successful partial results.

aggregates.name: Workspace
aggregates.responsibility: Own Workspace identity, direct memberships, invitations, account defaults, and typed resource references.
aggregates.consistencyBoundary: Membership and resource-link writes are scoped to one Workspace; an Identity Project may be referenced by at most one Workspace, and linking never changes Identity state.

entities.name: WorkspaceMembership
entities.responsibility: Represent direct owner, administrator, or member access to exactly one Workspace.

entities.name: WorkspaceInvitation
entities.identity: opaque invitation id and token digest
entities.responsibility: Track normalized recipient email, one Workspace, expiry, revocation, acceptance, and fixed login-project onboarding reference.

entities.name: WorkspaceResourceLink
entities.responsibility: Reference one externally owned resource from a Workspace; store link provenance only and no mirrored resource configuration or credentials.

entities.name: AccountWorkspaceDefault
entities.responsibility: Preserve the account's selected default Workspace, including My workspace.

valueObjects.name: WorkspaceResourceType
valueObjects.meaning: Registered type of an externally owned resource linked to a Workspace
rules: The first supported type is identity_project
Unknown types are rejected rather than treated as arbitrary data

valueObjects.name: IdentityProjectReference
valueObjects.meaning: Identity-owned Project identifier linked as a Workspace resource
rules: A reference can belong to at most one Workspace
Link/unlink never mutate the referenced Identity Project

valueObjects.name: NormalizedEmail

valueObjects.name: InvitationTokenDigest

policies: Identity remains the source of truth for Identity Projects, Clients, Applications, credentials, permissions, and lifecycle.
Workspace owner/admin can manage Workspace membership and resource links; Workspace members can read Workspace resources only.
Workspace roles never grant Identity permissions; every Identity read and link-validation call uses the signed-in user's current bearer authorization.
A user's active direct Workspace membership grants visibility to that Workspace only; there is no inherited cross-Workspace membership.
Identity 403 or inaccessible details produce a generic access-needed state; partial upstream failure does not expose private details or discard successful resource summaries.
Workspace invitation acceptance adds only the invited Workspace membership and grants no access to linked Identity Projects.
invariants: Each Workspace has exactly one active owner; ownership transfer preserves one owner throughout the committed transition.
Each Identity Project is linked to at most one Workspace, regardless of whether its former Platform Project was active or archived.
Unlinking removes only the Platform reference and never deletes, archives, or changes an Identity resource.
Migration preserves Workspace IDs, membership, invitations, and account defaults, and moves every existing Identity Project link directly to its parent Workspace.

Platform Project containers and their lifecycle state are removed from the active domain; linked Identity Projects remain visible as Workspace resources. Unlinked empty containers have no resource to migrate.
Workspace roles remain owner, admin, and member; only owner/admin can manage Workspace organization or resource links.
Platform stores typed external references, not a projection of Identity records or credentials; Workspace resource reads are live and actor-authorized.
Invitation acceptance requires unexpired, unrevoked state and normalized email equality; Identity onboarding failure never creates Workspace membership.

readModels.name: WorkspaceDirectory
readModels.purpose: Render the signed-in account's Workspaces and direct membership summaries.
readModels.source: Active direct Workspace memberships and Workspace summaries.

readModels.name: WorkspaceResourceSections
readModels.purpose: Render each available resource type as a section in its Workspace, starting with Identity Projects.
readModels.source: Typed Workspace resource links plus live, caller-authorized Identity API summaries; access and partial-upstream states remain explicit.

boundaries.domainOwner: talred-starter/apps/platform-api PlatformWorkspace and PlatformOrganization contexts; WorkspaceResourceLink replaces PlatformProject organization
boundaries.persistence: Platform API migrations and repositories in isolated talred_platform database; direct Workspace resource links replace Platform Project and Identity-link tables
boundaries.api: Versioned authenticated Platform API /api/platform/v1 owns Workspace, invitations, membership, typed resource-link, and Workspace resource-section contracts; Platform Project contracts are retired
boundaries.bff: talred-starter/apps/web server/api/platform proxies authenticated Platform API and preserves caller session scope
boundaries.client: Starter dashboard renders a Workspace resource directory with one section per type, initially Identity Projects, and localized loading, empty, access-needed, and unavailable states
boundaries.identity: talred-identity owns Identity Project data, permissions, Clients, Applications, and lifecycle; the Platform uses the signed-in user's bearer for reads and link validation
boundaries.runtime: Existing local-dev-ops Platform API, Identity, Starter web, and isolated Platform database runtime; no new service or external provider

acceptanceCriteria: The existing My workspace ID, direct memberships, invitations, and default selection are preserved by the migration.

All Identity Project links currently stored through Platform Projects are migrated directly to their parent Workspace, including links under archived containers; the two Identity Projects under Talred Project remain visible in that Workspace after migration.
An Identity Project can be linked to one Workspace only; owner/admin can link and unlink it, while members remain read-only and Workspace roles grant no Identity permission.
Workspace detail renders separate typed resource sections, initially an Identity Projects section listing directly linked Projects without a Platform Project wrapper.
Identity summaries are fetched live with the signed-in user's authorization; inaccessible details are generic, partial failures retain successful items, and no credentials are exposed.
Link, unlink, and migration never create, update, archive, delete, or change access to Identity resources.
Platform Project create, archive, restore, and nested identity-link routes and client contracts are removed or replaced by Workspace resource-link contracts.
English and French workspace resource interfaces cover loading, empty, unavailable, access-needed, and success states; affected API, BFF, and client contracts are verified.

assumptions.statement: An Identity Project should be linked to at most one Workspace, preserving the previous one-container rule at the Workspace boundary.

Existing Platform Project names, empty containers, and active/archive state have no independent lifecycle after the two Identity Project links are moved to Workspace resources; the resource link itself remains available regardless of former container state.
Workspace invitations and fixed-login-project onboarding remain unchanged by the resource organization redesign.

decisions: Workspace is the product's resource-organization boundary; remove the intermediate Platform Project aggregate and UI.
Represent externally owned resources with a typed WorkspaceResourceLink; implement Identity Project as the first resource type and add other type-specific integrations when needed.
Identity Projects remain Identity-owned. The Platform stores a reference and retrieves authorized detail live; it does not mirror Identity configuration or credentials.
Migrate every current Identity Project link to its existing parent Workspace, independent of former Platform Project archive status, then retire Platform Project contracts and storage.
Continue direct Workspace membership/invitation authorization and keep the fixed-login-project invitation flow unchanged.
